There is a Varsity Girls Basketball game scheduled from 9AM - 11AM on the day of the competition. No extras will be given for noise emanating from the gymnasium. If this will be an issue for you, we highly advise you do not register.

This competition will utilize the "running judge" system where judges are expected to run as well. Please be sure you are familiar with all regulations. If there is anything preventing you from being able to run, please let us know ahead of time so we can plan accordingly.

Depending on the number of competitors who sign up, the advancement conditions may need to change.
